documents.title: Advisor meeting notes - 12 Feb 2026
documents.content: Met with Maria to review her income plan. She wants to keep annual spending around $110,000 and travel twice a year. Her pension covers about 60% of spending; the rest comes from portfolio withdrawals. We discussed delaying Social Security benefits to age 70 to maximize lifetime payments. She asked about required minimum distributions from her IRA starting next year. Action items: model withdrawal scenarios and review long-term care options.

documents.title: Source of wealth declaration
documents.content: The client declares that the majority of their wealth originates from the sale of Acme AI Inc., a software company they co-founded in 2018. The acquisition by a public technology company closed in January 2026. The client's share of proceeds was approximately $18.5 million after taxes and fees. Supporting evidence includes the share purchase agreement and the escrow release letter. Remaining wealth comes from salary savings and vested stock options.

documents.title: Investment policy statement
documents.content: This statement defines the objectives and constraints for the Smith family portfolio. The strategic mix is 55% global equities, 25% fixed income, 10% private equity and 10% real assets. The portfolio is rebalanced when any sleeve drifts more than 5 percentage points from target. Liquidity needs are modest, with expected annual distributions of 3%. Investments in tobacco and weapons manufacturers are excluded. Performance is benchmarked against a blended index and reviewed quarterly.
